title: Peameal Bacon Sandwich
description: Peameal Bacon Sandwich is a dish from Canada prepared with pork loin, cornmeal, burger bun, yellow mustard. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Uncured lean pork loin crusted with cornmeal replaces cured Canadian peameal bacon.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 120 minutes.
Pat dry, then coat evenly with the listed breading or flour components; press lightly to help it adhere.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 18 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
